label: CIG XG-99C1 XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON SFU ONT with 1× 10GBase-T LAN and no Wi-Fi; SC/APC optical, Class N1 budget, OMCI management, 12 V DC external adapter drawing under 10 W.
notes: One of two SKUs in the datasheet's model table: 'XG-99C1 — XGS-PON SFU ONT, 10 Gbps symmetric, 1× 10GBase-T LAN, SC/APC optical, OMCI, AES-128' and 'XG-99C2 — XGS-PON SFU ONT, 10 Gbps symmetric, 1× 10GBase-T LAN, 10GE + 1GE, SC/APC optical, OMCI, AES-128'. This entry is the 10GE-only SKU; the second Ethernet port makes the other a different device, because the interface list cannot tell them apart. Optical: ITU-T G.9807.1 Class N1, 10 Gbit/s symmetric, up to 20 km, +4 to +9 dBm TX, -28 dBm RX. The 10GE port is 10GBase-T RJ-45, compatible with 5G/2.5G/1GBase-T by auto-negotiation. Power: 12 V DC external adapter, under 10 W. No Wi-Fi.
